rule: Founder §24: every material mutant is detected or explicitly justified. A survivor is recorded here with the reason its effect is unreachable, masked by another rule of the model, or confined to a direction that cannot promote a projection into history. Each entry is keyed by the mutation's exact name in mutation-check-r7asm.out.json.

documented.§24 load execution copies tick: the repe: Detected by the regression gate, not by the unit suites, which the mutation harness is the only thing that runs. Applying it makes probes/rows-h24-h29.mjs report allRisenAreEffortGuided = false, with R6-H29's db-row rising from a 6-repetition to a 10-repetition target at the same known 22 kg: a dose increase at an unchanged load. That gate is checked by verify-r7asm.mjs ('regression'). The rule it removes was itself a fix found during this build, from the same corpus case.
documented.§24 load execution copies tick: the view: Equivalent in the states the corpora and probes reach. The tick reset at a load the state had not reached now applies in both transitions (earnedAt, unconditional), so a projection no longer diverges from history at the same load: wherever the view keeps the projection's load, the two credits coincide, and wherever the view lowers the load to history's, it takes history's credit with it. I could not construct a V1 path where the projection's credit at the view's own load differs from history's. The line is kept as the explicit statement of R42 in the view, and T7b, T7c and T6b assert the behaviour it encodes.
documented.§24 week boundary promotes target: the p: Equivalent. The reducer reads only evidence observed before the cut, and the cut lies inside week k, so applying one more week (k+1, which holds no reported session before the cut and whose start no decision has closed) changes nothing. T12 asserts the continuity the reader must have; P2 asserts that time alone moves nothing.
documented.§24 week boundary promotes target: a wee: Not reachable in the corpora, and conservative in direction. The clock only moves the look-back windows of a week already decided (repeated adverse responses, earned surplus, the last regression or return). Reading them at a later cut can only drop rows from those windows, which withholds an EARNED step; it cannot grant one or promote a value. No corpus case has such a window straddling a later reading (self-challenge C8 and P2 read the same history five weeks later and find it unchanged).
documented.§24 partial evidence fills projection: a: Closed by test after a first justification proved wrong. The mutant writes the row's planned load into the facts-only state. Every history reader re-derives the load from the executed dose (historicalStrength), so the public reader and a return both mask it; only a decision that plans from the view sees it, because the view takes the reducer's state as it stands. T10c was extended with that step (an equipment change re-plans the week after the unreadable exposure, and its row must be the last readable load), and it was verified to fail under the mutant and pass without it.
documented.§24 cross-exercise promotion: an exercis: Not reachable through a decision. The view is built only for the decision's own week, so the exercise would have to be in that week's stored start and absent from history: a review never sets up an exercise the athlete did not perform (SSCTR D52), and where a projection sets one up, the next decision that re-plans that week drops it (T13c, T13d). Every construction tried either swapped the exercise out with the same change or left it only in weeks the decision re-plans as projections, where a projection may assume its establishment (Founder §14).
documented.an exercise the evidence never establish: Same root as the entry above, and asserted from the other side: T13c shows such an exercise is absent from HistoricalState and that its next exposure is a first establishment. The mutant's remaining effect is confined to the projected weeks a decision does not re-plan from the view.
documented.the re-establishment threshold of a move: Bounded to the admissibility of a same-week move. The window decides whether a session may move to a later slot of its own sport (`sameKind`); it reads no value into history and promotes nothing. The regression records the one corpus case it changes (R6-H18, class DECISION_FROM_VIEW), where the move becomes a KEEP with zero work and no debt.
documented.the gates of a decision read the stored: The atoms the gates take from a start are the run's mode and an exercise's return step. The view takes the whole run from history whenever history is in a return, so the mode agrees; `returning` is a presence test on the return step, which both readings answer alike in every path the suites reach. A divergence could only withhold an EARNED step (`noEarned`), never promote a value.
